# pantechdynamics_container_repository (Data Source)

Looks up one repository in your organization's container registry namespace by id or name, for example to get its full_name for an image reference without managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a repository up by name (or by id), for example to reference its image.
data "pantechdynamics_container_repository" "api" {
  name = "api/server"
}

output "api_image" {
  value = "${data.pantechdynamics_container_repository.api.full_name}:v1.4.2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the repository to look up, starting with crr_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the repository inside the namespace, such as "api/server". It must match exactly; names are unique in the namespace. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the repository was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `description` (String) The repository's description.
- `full_name` (String) The image name to tag and pull, such as "registry.pantechdynamics.com/acme/api/server".
- `immutable_tags` (Boolean) Whether tags, once pushed, cannot move or be deleted.
- `last_pushed_at` (String) When an image was last pushed, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second, or null.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace the repository is in.
- `retention` (Attributes) The cleanup policy, or null for none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention))
- `status` (String) "active", "deleting" or "suspended".
- `storage_bytes` (Number) Storage the repository's images use, in bytes.
- `tag_count` (Number) How many tags the repository holds.
- `visibility` (String) "private" or "public" (anyone can pull).

<a id="nestedatt--retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention`

Read-Only:

- `keep_last` (Number) Only the newest this many tags are kept, or null.
- `keep_pattern` (String) Tags matching this glob are always kept, or null.
- `untagged_after_days` (Number) Untagged images older than this many days are deleted, or null.
